fact: The digital transition minister said AI will check candidate files, generate the questions and mark the papers in the competitive recruitment of 3,000 civil servants, with tools already tested in the past, under a draft decree approved by the Council of Ministers.

fact: Erribat.info reports that the Minister of Youth Empowerment, Employment, Sports and Civil Service launched Mourchid, a government AI assistant working in Arabic and French that answers on jobs, civil service, youth and sports programmes from ministry databases and official documents, with voice search, around the clock.

Agence Ecofin reports that Mauritanian authorities announced on 26 December 2025 an AI road-safety solution, developed by the Agence numérique de l'État and operated by the national police (DGSN), now operational on the national road network with cameras detecting vehicle overloading and unworn seat belts.

fact: The digital transformation ministry (MTNIMA) says it and the national security directorate (DGSN) ran the 2026 police recruitment exam with AI checking the authenticity of 1,459 applications via Khidmaty (513 retained), AI-generated questions and automatic marking.
